filters.q: {(to:demo+invoices@appbuilder.ai is:unread) (to:daniel@tigros.io {filename:pdf subject:invoice subject:factura})} -"Sent by the AppBuilder.ai invoice worker"

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'source_message_id', operator: 'EQ', value: $('Build Document Text').item.json.source_message_id }] }], properties: ['dealname','dealstage','document_type','invoice_number','invoice_date','due_date','po_number','amount','vat_amount','iban_on_invoice','match_result','approval_level','anomaly_flags','exception_reason','order_channel','min_field_confidence'], limit: 1 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'supplier_status', operator: 'HAS_PROPERTY' }] }], properties: ['name','supplier_status','supplier_vat_id','supplier_iban','previous_iban','iban_changed_on','tax_certificate_valid_until','domain'], limit: 100 }) }}

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are the accounts-payable desk of a bank. First classify document_type as one of: invoice, credit_note, reminder, question, other. For invoices and credit notes extract: supplier_name, vat_id, iban, invoice_number, invoice_date and due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, currency, net_amount, vat_amount, total_amount, and every line (item_code as written, description, quantity, unit_price, line_total), each line with a confidence between 0 and 1. Also give a confidence between 0 and 1 for supplier_name, vat_id, iban, invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number and total_amount. For a question or reminder write a two-sentence summary in the summary field. Never invent values: leave a text field as an empty string and a number as 0 when it is not on the document.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'po_number', operator: 'EQ', value: ($('Read Document').item.json.output.po_number || 'NONE') }, { propertyName: 'document_type', operator: 'EQ', value: 'purchase_order' }] }], properties: ['dealname','po_number','budget_code','po_requester','dealstage'], limit: 5 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'associations.deal', operator: 'EQ', value: $json.results[0].id }] }], properties: ['hs_sku','name','quantity','price','received_quantity','delivery_note_ref'], limit: 100 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'document_type', operator: 'EQ', value: 'invoice' }, { propertyName: 'associations.company', operator: 'EQ', value: ($('Match Supplier').item.json.supplier ? $('Match Supplier').item.json.supplier.id : '0') }] }], properties: ['invoice_number','amount','invoice_date','dealstage','po_number'], limit: 100 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { hs_note_body: 'Payment reminder received ' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), hs_timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }, associations: [{ to: { id: $json.reminder_target_deal_id }, types: [{ associationCategory: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', associationTypeId: 214 }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: $json.deal_properties, associations: $json.supplier_id ? [{ to: { id: $json.supplier_id }, types: [{ associationCategory: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', associationTypeId: 5 }] }] : [] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ inputs: $('Apply Rules').item.json.line_items.map((l) => ({ properties: l, associations: [{ to: { id: $json.id }, types: [{ associationCategory: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', associationTypeId: 20 }] }] })) }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { hs_note_body: $('Apply Rules').item.json.audit_html, hs_timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }, associations: [{ to: { id: $('Create Invoice Deal').item.json.id }, types: [{ associationCategory: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', associationTypeId: 214 }] }] }) }}
